purpose: Compare a batched interval-contraction heuristic with uniform and a transparent maximin-width/shared-cost adaptation. No diffusion, DP, clinical efficacy, or optimality claim.
confidence: Two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson at every declared look, with tail error beta/(2 defenses * 3 attacks * 2 strata * 2 thresholds * 16 looks * 2 tails). Union bound valid despite correlated scores and adaptive action selection. No optional extra looks.
patient_sampling: Independent uniform latent per patient within each stratum; score marginals generated by declared categorical laws. Same patient latent shared across all defenses/attacks and all algorithms. Strata independent. Per-score observations are prefixes of the fixed IID stream. Repeated features do not add patients.

nested_sharing.cost_rule: Pay only the difference between the requested cumulative level and each patient's cached level.

leader_challenger: leader=argmin defense upper risk; challenger=argmin other defense lower risk; fixed lexicographic tie breaks
active_attack: attack upper risk >= same-defense lower risk
valid_stop: leader upper risk < every other defense lower risk
forced_exploration: At rounds 1,2,4,8,... choose round-robin action indexed by log2(round) modulo 12, skipping exhausted/unaffordable actions. Applied to every algorithm.
uniform: Round-robin through all 12 (defense,bundle,stratum) actions outside forced rounds; each action advances its defining attack by 128 patients.
maximin_width_shared_cost_adaptation: Among leader/challenger active actions, maximize sum over newly observed active attacks of risk-interval-width times maximum stratum-band-width at any upper/lower witness threshold, divided by incremental cached cost. Cold active count/cost then fixed action ID break ties. This is not an exact M-LUCB or TaS-FG replication.
batched_v0: Hypothetically contract actual bands around clipped empirical survival by sqrt((n+1)/(n+129)) for newly observed active attacks. Leave n=0 bands unchanged. Recompute exact finite-threshold ROC risk; maximize reduction in current leader-upper minus challenger-lower divided by cost. Break ties by first active observation count/cost, then total maximum-band-width reduction/cost, then fixed ID. Proxy never updates evidence.
setup_fit_cost: Zero: all score functions supplied/frozen. This simulation does not validate savings in attack fitting/setup.
comparison_limits: Allocation cannot access true score laws, exact risks, unqueried scores, or other algorithm outcomes. All algorithms have identical streams, confidence bands, cache rights and budget. Cases intentionally construct member/null bottlenecks; not representative medical observations. No parameter changes after seeing results.
allowed_run: CPU only, one predeclared run; preserve adverse/zero-decision outcomes. No GPU or new model training.
